runtime_changes_retained.change: For codes containing ASCII letters, preserve legacy ASCII normalization. For Arabic-only codes, retain Unicode letters and normalize Arabic digits.
runtime_changes_retained.necessary_for: Six confirmed Arabic-prefix identity collisions in three affected programs.
runtime_changes_retained.data_only_alternative: Not safely equivalent without replacing official displayed course codes or introducing a new API-visible key/alias model.
runtime_changes_retained.availability_effect: Only corrected identities and their stored chains; no initial state changes.
runtime_changes_retained.api_behavior_detail: API shape and prerequisite semantics are unchanged; interpretation of legacy ambiguous numeric completed codes changes for the six collision identities.

runtime_changes_retained.change: Mirror the targeted Arabic-only normalization used by the server.
runtime_changes_retained.necessary_for: Consistent Python validation/planning of the same six identity collisions.

runtime_changes_retained.change: Mirror the targeted Arabic-only course key normalization for UI selection and status lookup.
runtime_changes_retained.necessary_for: Prevent the six confirmed Arabic-prefix identities from sharing checkbox/status keys.
runtime_changes_retained.data_only_alternative: Would require replacing official displayed codes or a new separate planner-key field.
runtime_changes_retained.local_storage_detail: The storage key is unchanged. Prefix-preserving validation and additive migration metadata prevent ambiguous legacy numeric values from selecting the wrong course.

runtime_changes_retained.change: Apply a versioned per-program migration: preserve unaffected values, auto-map unique identities, back up ambiguous values, and record explicit reconfirmation.
runtime_changes_retained.necessary_for: Conservative handling of legacy localStorage values for the six confirmed collisions.
runtime_changes_retained.data_only_alternative: No; browser-local legacy values must be interpreted at load time.
runtime_changes_retained.availability_effect: Ambiguous legacy values no longer falsely complete any candidate; explicit reconfirmation then uses normal planner behavior.

runtime_changes_retained.change: Add the approved non-blocking bilingual reconfirmation notice and candidate controls.
runtime_changes_retained.necessary_for: Allow the user to resolve ambiguous legacy selections without guessing or resetting progress.
runtime_changes_retained.data_only_alternative: No; user reconfirmation requires a UI.
runtime_changes_retained.availability_effect: None until the user reconfirms a candidate.

runtime_changes_reverted.reason: The three identity-collision programs have no elective groups; generalized Unicode normalization was unnecessary and could broaden elective behavior.

sallam_401.previous_false_identity_match: ASCII-only normalization reduced سلم 101 and ID 101 to 101, so completing available ID 101 falsely satisfied the missing سلم 101 link. It also reduced غ ت 401 and سلم 401 to 401.
sallam_401.corrected_identity: سلم401 (distinct from ID101, غت401, and other numeric-only collisions)
sallam_401.blocking_cause: سلم 101 is absent from this same planner dataset; therefore سلم 201 cannot unlock, followed by سلم 301 and سلم 401.
sallam_401.evidence_conclusion: The retained official structured KAU row supports the displayed stored chain, but no raw same-program text establishes how to supply the missing سلم 101. The blocked state is structurally correct for stored data; its academic completeness remains evidence-insufficient.

persistence_review.local_storage_payload_schema_change: Additive course_identity_migration field, version 1, inside the existing per-program saved value.
persistence_review.production_main_presence: All three affected programs exist as active FULL_PLANNER records on local main and on this branch.
persistence_review.migration_status: Implemented locally. The migration is per-program, additive, versioned, and idempotent; it never changes another program's key or value.

policy.unambiguous_numeric_values: Automatically replaced by the sole prefix-preserving same-program identity.
policy.ambiguous_numeric_values: Removed from active completed_codes, retained with all candidates in backup metadata, and require explicit reconfirmation.
policy.guessing: No title, level, numbering, prerequisite order, or other-program inference is used.
policy.cleanup: Backup metadata remains after reconfirmation. No cleanup policy is implemented.

ambiguous_entry.resolution: null until explicit reconfirmation, then selected identity

persistence_review.notice: One-time pending bilingual notice uses the approved English and Arabic text, lists candidate courses, provides reconfirmation buttons, does not block the planner, and hides only after every ambiguous value is reconfirmed.
persistence_review.saved_api_progress_interpretation: No API persistence schema or behavior was changed; this migration applies only to the existing browser-local progress record.
persistence_review.planner_behavior: Initial availability remains 1,378 available and 835 blocked; API permanently blocked rows remain 237 after remediation. Accounting, Finance, Finance ISLS 201, and OFFICIAL_PLAN_VIEW behavior are unchanged.
persistence_review.tests: 101 unit tests passed, including 7 focused migration tests; full 72-program simulation and 15 OFFICIAL_PLAN_VIEW read-only tests passed.
persistence_review.safety_conclusion: The previously unresolved localStorage ambiguity has a conservative, non-destructive resolution.
